_note: Craft styling ideas. Each id switches html.craft-<id>. Staging shows a checklist to turn them on and off.

groups.label: The shop drawing
groups.blurb: Precise and measured, like plans pinned over the bench.

groups.label: The finish schedule
groups.blurb: The finish going on: oil and end grain.

groups.label: The workbench
groups.blurb: Hand-marked, physical, the shop at work.

groups.label: The craft as proof
groups.blurb: Content that needs real details from the shop.

items.name: Howling logo intro
items.what: On the first page of a visit, the header wolf throws its head back and howls (sound arcs ripple from its muzzle) while the lettering zooms in. Once per visit, never with reduced motion.

items.name: Dimension lines
items.what: Section headings get a measured dimension line. Product pages show a plan-view drawing of the board that redraws when you change the size.

items.name: Cut list spec table
items.what: The product's choices read like a woodworker's cut list: part, spec, quantity. Updates as you configure.

items.name: Story stick
items.what: A ruler down the left edge that fills as you scroll. Wide desktop screens only.

items.name: Maker's mark
items.what: The wolf mark pressed into product photos like a hot-iron brand, and stamped on a finished order.

items.name: Oil sheen
items.what: The final, oiled section catches a slow pass of light across the badge when it arrives.

items.name: End-grain loader
items.what: While a photo or the server is working, a small checkerboard fills in tile by tile, like the end-grain boards.

items.name: Lumber crayon marks
items.what: Demo-price and seasonal tags look marked in red lumber crayon. Quantity also shows as tally marks.

items.name: The making sequence
items.what: Custom page walks through rough lumber, milled, glued up, flattened, oiled. Missing steps show where a shop photo is needed.

items.name: Glue-up cart
items.what: Adding to the cart clamps the bag icon and squeezes the new line into place, like a glue-up.

items.name: Saw cut between sections
items.what: On the homepage, a spinning saw blade runs along the line above “Made to order”, then that section drops down into place.

items.name: Board passport
items.what: Each piece gets a provenance card: wood, source, shop hours, finish, oiled-on date. Needs real details from the shop.

items.name: Growth-ring timeline
items.what: The shop's story as growth rings around the badge, one ring per milestone. Needs the real years from the shop.

items.name: Collierville map with parallax
items.what: A stylised map of Collierville in the brand colours (roads in cream and maple, the Wolf River in padauk) drifts behind the “One shop” section as you scroll. Map data from OpenStreetMap.
